builder.description: Build a change through the seven-stage pipeline, run several at once with nexus, and keep the work it starts from and ships

placed.backlog: maps and splits the stories and slices a build starts from
placed.ticket: opens, links and closes the work items a build answers to
placed.release-notes: turns a shipped version into what users can now do; the operations README says it stands alone from the response chain

reviewer.description: Review a change as it arrives: prepare it, read its history, review the code, its tests and its concurrency, and learn from past reviews

placed.appsec: where peer-review's security lens escalates; harness/prreview.py brings it in at the PR tier

on-call.description: Respond to a running system: hotfix, incident, post-mortem, the tracker that holds the follow-ups, and a misbehaving container

placed.container-debug: for a container misbehaving in production; it hands application bugs to hotfix, and incident-fix gathers evidence with its tables

platform.description: Build and run the platform: images, stacks, orchestration, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and the hosts underneath

placed.hardening: reviews the hosts and cloud accounts the platform runs on

data.description: Architect, audit, design, diagram, propose, build and tune relational databases

network.description: Audit, design, diagram, propose and blueprint networks

security.description: Threat-model a system, then review its application code, its hosts and cloud, and its containers

placed.container-hardening: the security review of the container layer
